messages:
alex_sales: Prospect (EuroPay) wants a 10-day POC with EU-only processing, BYOK for keys, and a subprocessors list. also asked whether a short-term region-pinned dedicated pool is possible and cost impact.

solutions_noor: short yes: we can pin tenant to eu-central-1 and provide a subprocessors snapshot. need to confirm BYOK lead time.

infra_lina: routing policy snippet we use: `route_policy: tenant_pin, region: eu-central-1, fallback: eu-fallback` 12 cache and model state stay local. control-plane metadata may still cross regions unless Private.

sec_paul: BYOK onboarding 3-5bd. fast alternative: ephemeral customer-isolated keys (Redwood-managed) for POC if they accept a scoping addendum and short retention limits.

product_rachel: pricing: short dedicated pool => estimate +15% hourly for 10-day term. full BYOK adds an onboarding fee (~1 eng day). ephemeral option removes onboarding fee.

legal_ani: for POC we can provide a signed subprocessors snapshot (date-stamped) + one-page scoping addendum. contractual zero-egress requires Private deployment.

ops-bot: provision request queued: transient-pool eu-central-1 (tag: euro-pay-poc). awaiting size + approval.

alex_sales: I'll propose ephemeral-key + signed snapshot to meet start date; will escalate if customer insists on BYOK. thanks all. :thumbsup:
